integrity: All stated equalities use the standard ordinary sum-of-divisors function and the prime-product-rule arithmetic derivative. The infinite classification is proved by complete exponent-pattern cases; the finite verifier is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem restricted to \(n\ge2\) with \(\Omega(n)\le4\); the value \(n=1\) is outside the domain; \(n=396\) is a next-layer witness; no classification of \(\Omega(n)\ge5\).
title: Complete low-multiplicity classification of arithmetic-derivative/aliquot coincidences
